# 1033. Moving Stones Until Consecutive

## Solution 1 (time O(1), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def numMovesStones(self, a, b, c):
        """
        :type a: int
        :type b: int
        :type c: int
        :rtype: List[int]
        """
        a, b, c = sorted([a, b, c])
        if b - a == 1 and c - b == 1:
            return [0, 0]
        if b - a <= 2 or c - b <= 2:
            return [1, c - a - 2]
        return [2, c - a - 2]
```
